PowerBill Estimator calculates your monthly electricity bill using block tariff rates, applies your rebate, and stores every result in an offline SQLite database so you can review, edit or delete it later.
Tap the link or the button to open the project page on GitHub.
No browser found to open the link.

1. Select the billing month from the Month dropdown (January – December).

2. Type the electricity used in kWh. Only whole numbers from 1 to 1000 are accepted. A red error message appears if the field is empty or out of range.

3. Drag the Rebate slider to choose a rebate from 0% to 5%.

4. Tap Calculate & Save. The total charges, rebate, final cost and a block-by-block breakdown appear on the same page, and the result is saved in the local database.

5. Tap the clock icon (History) in the title bar, or the View saved bills button, to see all saved bills listed by month with their final cost.

6. Tap any bill in the list to open its details: month, units, total charges, rebate and final cost.

7. On the details page, tap Edit to change the month, units or rebate and then Save changes, or tap Delete to remove the bill.

8. Tap Reset on the main page to clear the form.

How charges work: the first 200 kWh cost 21.8 sen each, the next 100 kWh cost 33.4 sen, the next 300 kWh cost 51.6 sen, and every kWh above 600 costs 54.6 sen.
